description: Utility functions for managing and processing post lists in Mattermost Redux, including filtering, combining, and generating post data with date separators and user activity aggregation.

methods.name: makePreparePostIdsForPostList
methods.description: Creates a selector that filters posts, adds date and new message separators, and combines user activity posts based on state and options.

methods.name: makeFilterPostsAndAddSeparators
methods.description: Creates a selector that filters posts by various criteria, adds date headers, and optionally indicates new messages.

methods.name: pushPostDateIfNeeded
methods.description: Adds a date separator to the output array if the current post's date differs from the last post's date, considering timezone adjustments.

methods.name: makeAddDateSeparatorsForSearchResults
methods.description: Creates a selector that adds date separators to a list of search result posts.

methods.name: makeCombineUserActivityPosts
methods.description: Creates a selector that combines consecutive user activity posts into a single post ID.

methods.name: isStartOfNewMessages
methods.description: Checks if a post ID indicates the start of new messages.

methods.name: getTimestampForStartOfNewMessages
methods.description: Extracts timestamp from a start-of-new-messages post ID.

methods.name: getNewMessagesIndex
methods.description: Finds the index of the start-of-new-messages indicator in a list.

methods.name: isCreateComment
methods.description: Checks if a string indicates a create comment marker.

methods.name: isDateLine
methods.description: Checks if a string indicates a date separator.

methods.name: getDateForDateLine
methods.description: Extracts date timestamp from a date line string.

methods.name: isCombinedUserActivityPost
methods.description: Checks if a string matches the pattern for combined user activity posts.

methods.name: getPostIdsForCombinedUserActivityPost
methods.description: Splits a combined user activity post ID into individual post IDs.

methods.name: getFirstPostId
methods.description: Retrieves the first post ID from a list, considering combined posts and separators.

methods.name: getLastPostId
methods.description: Retrieves the last post ID from a list, considering combined posts and separators.

methods.name: getLastPostIndex
methods.description: Finds the index of the last valid post in a list, ignoring separators.

methods.name: makeGenerateCombinedPost
methods.description: Creates a function to generate a combined user activity post from multiple posts.

methods.name: extractUserActivityData
methods.description: Processes activity entries to extract user IDs, usernames, and message data.

methods.name: combineUserActivitySystemPost
methods.description: Combines multiple system posts into a single user activity post, merging similar activities.

methods.name: isUsersRelatedPost
methods.description: Checks if a post type is related to user membership changes.

methods.name: mergeLastSimilarPosts
methods.description: Merges the last two user activity entries if they are of the same type.

methods.name: isSameActorsInUserActivities
methods.description: Checks if two user activity entries have the same set of actors.

methods.name: isUserActivityProp
methods.description: Type guard to verify if an object conforms to UserActivityProp structure.
